card.title: Talk Around the Mess
card.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's coming for lunch. Is this spoon clean enough for her?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The spoon's fine. You haven't cleaned the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: She checks cutlery. Could you check the forks while I finish this?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've told her to bring rubber gloves and help you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we need a guest towel. Can you help me choose one without a faded stripe?

mechanism: A keeps attention on cutlery and a guest towel to avoid the undone kitchen-cleaning responsibility.
confusable: Unlike ordinary thoroughness, small finishing details must displace the larger acknowledged unfinished task.
comparison: D38-a converts incoming cleanup help into towel selection; D38-b converts van arrival into another label-color decision.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
